findings.claim: dotbrand automates early client communication for designers and agencies to align project expectations.

quotes.text: dotbrand solves this by automating the early stages of client communication (before the down payment), helping designers and agencies gather key information, align project expectations, and send reports to both the client and the design team before investing a lot of time.

findings.reason: The quote describes dotbrand automating early client communication to align expectations, matching the claim exactly.
findings.limitations: Limited to dotbrand's specific process, not general applicability.

findings.claim: Freelancers struggle to get clients to pay their invoices on time.

quotes.text: Click start on the timer at the beginning of the call, click stop when you've ended the call, create invoice, add time entry, send to client (via email through Harpoon).
I might hound Joe down the street for that $10 he never paid me back for the rest of my days, but I can accept losing a few days of billable time because my client went bankrupt and can't pay me.

findings.reason: The quotes describe a freelancer's experience with late payments and accepting lost billable time due to client bankruptcy, but the context shows this is a personal example of risk acceptance, not a general struggle with timely payments.
findings.limitations: Limited to one freelancer's specific situation, not representative of all freelancers.
